---
title: "Leak canary"
---

This file exists to be found. It carries a string that appears nowhere else in
the repository, and it sits in the one directory the render allowlist must never
sweep in.

If this page ever renders into `docs/`, the allowlist has been broken and every
answer key beside it is one push away from being public. `make leakcheck` reads
every byte under `docs/` looking for the string below and refuses on a hit.

Do not delete this file, do not render it, and do not copy the string anywhere
else. A second copy makes the check fire on something harmless, and a check
people learn to ignore is worse than no check.

{{canary}}
